mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot.iot_data_quality_stat (device_id, stat_date, expected_count, received_count, missing_rate, anomaly_count, quality_score, updated_by) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{statDate}, #{expectedCount}, #{receivedCount}, #{missingRate}, #{anomalyCount}, #{qualityScore}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (device_id, stat_date) DO UPDATE SET expected_count = EXCLUDED.expected_count, received_count = EXCLUDED.received_count, missing_rate = EXCLUDED.missing_rate, anomaly_count = EXCLUDED.anomaly_count, quality_score = EXCLUDED.quality_score, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
